fails_if: the provider slug loader scopes variant or variable slugs provider-wide, or refuses a split sibling that shares its own base family's slug
note: Variant and variable slugs are unique per parent register, so the same slug under registers 34 and 26 is no collision. A split sibling (34.4.kon) may share its own base family's slug in a provider file; the register tree adds the identity-declaration requirement (slugs-split-sibling-without-identity-reuses-base-slug-refused).
